nodes.label: AI Export catalog granularity and composition
nodes.description: Concept page describing the 32-dataset/17-analysis/65-component AI Export catalog, PAC/rebalancing per-position and optional per-Asset composition, three price semantics, canonical all_data union, UI granularity confusion, two contract gaps, and the 49/49 verification run.

nodes.label: 32 datasets + 17 analyses + 65 components
nodes.description: Current public AI Export catalog counts: 32 DatasetSpec entries and 17 AnalysisSpec entries composed from 65 reusable ComponentSpec builders across Portfolio, Broker, Asset, and FX domains.
nodes.source_location: Where It Applies / Public catalog table

nodes.label: PAC/rebalancing per-position and optional per-Asset data
nodes.description: pac_planning and rebalancing always compose overview/performance_flows giving per-position Asset/Broker rows (quantity, unit price, value, WAC, P&L, weight), and optionally compose asset_snapshot/asset_comparison/drawdown_context for per-Asset observed market context — not aggregate-only.
nodes.source_location: PAC and rebalancing are not aggregate-only

nodes.label: Three distinct price semantics
nodes.description: The word 'price' covers three distinct facts in AI Export: position unit price (Overview), observed market price (Asset Snapshot/Comparison), and price history (bucketed Technical time series) — related but not interchangeable.

nodes.label: all_data canonical complete-dataset union
nodes.description: *.all_data is the deduplicated union of each domain's canonical complete source datasets (e.g. Portfolio Overview+Performance/Flows+Technical+FIFO), deliberately excluding focused projections/evidence/comparisons that would duplicate rows and semantics.

nodes.label: UI confusion between granularity/data-shape choices
nodes.description: Users cannot currently tell whether a catalog choice is aggregate, per-Asset, current-state, historical, position-accounting, market-context, or evidence-only; Technical Summary/Asset Snapshot/Asset Comparison/Technical are the most confused, plus Overview-vs-Performance and context-dataset-vs-analysis collisions. No granularity badges exist; candidate cues (Aggregated, Per Asset, Current price, Price history, Lots) are findings for future product discussion only.

nodes.label: Broker Technical raw price-history gap
nodes.description: broker.technical contains coverage, indicator history, events, and breadth but no raw OHLC/price-history component comparable to Portfolio, Asset, or FX complete technical exports; current price remains available only via Broker Overview or Asset Comparison. Not changed by the discovery/report.

nodes.label: Asset Trend promises Drawdown without composing it
nodes.description: The Italian UI description of asset.trend_analysis mentions drawdown ed eventi, but its AnalysisSpec requires only asset.overview and asset.market_technical; asset.drawdown_context is not included, and the instruction/response contract likewise omit a supplied Drawdown section. Not changed by the discovery/report.

nodes.label: 49/49 catalog review and validation run 20260804T085052.052297Z
nodes.description: The 4 August review explained all 49/49 public choices against the live runtime catalog, payload models, instructions, response contracts, and Italian labels (following live _PORTFOLIO_ANALYSES/_BROKER_ANALYSES/_ASSET_ANALYSES/_FX_ANALYSES declarations, not the stale docstring mapping). Five representative Portfolio prompts were generated and read in real_prompt_probe/20260804T085052.052297Z, passing 5/5 with zero failures, zero public-output violations, UI/probe equivalence, a passed secret scan, and unchanged source/production databases.
